evidence.purpose: five-observation collection and fail-closed promotion guard

rationale: The comparable v2 cohort is complete at five observations with a measured 8.77% timing reduction, below the 25% target.
Rerun reduction is unmeasurable because the comparable baseline and cohort both contain zero reruns.
No first-actionable-failure sample exists, so TTAF improvement cannot be accepted as measured.
The execution-canary ledger is collection-complete but remains promotion-ineligible and dependency-heavy profiles remain fail-closed.
constraints: Do not promote affected profiles to blocking on this evidence.
Do not suppress dependency profiles or retry product failures to green.
Revisit the decision only with a comparable baseline and an actionable-failure cohort.
